name: Recuperación de contraseña — flujo estático y token inválido

planSteps.description: A link with the text '¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?' is visible
The page shows a heading with the text 'Recuperar contraseña' and an input field for email
The Turnstile CAPTCHA widget (an iframe from challenges.cloudflare.com) is visible in the page
The page shows a heading 'Error' and an error message containing 'Link inválido o expirado.'
A button with the text 'Solicitar nuevo link' is visible, and it links back to /login/recuperar
